sentences.text:
...RESPONDENTS  THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED. 29.08.2015,
PASSED IN MVC NO.4454/2013, ON THE FILE OF THE I- ADDITIONAL SMALL CAUSES JUDGE AND XXVII ACMM.,
BENGALURU (SCCH-11), AWARDING GLOBAL COMPENSATION OF RS.6,000/- A/W. INTEREST AT THE RATE OF 6 PERCENT P.A., FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL COMPLETE REALIZSATION.

THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Learned counsel for the appellant who is physically present once again prays for a week's time.
2. A perusal of the order sheet would go to show that in this appeal of the year 2021, the appellant had more than two years time to ensure that his appeal is bereft of any office objections.
The appellant is an Insurance Company, which, for two years has not made a statutory deposit, which is the sole objection for compliance.

3. Several and sufficient time, for not less than five times, was given to comply with office objections,
despite which, the appellant has not complied the same.
Hence, I do not find any reason to grant time, though prayed for, by the learned counsel for the appellant.
Accordingly, appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
